--json.description: Emit the versioned payload as JSON

--session.description: Aggregate a single Claude Code session

--since.description: Workspace window lower bound (ISO date); default last 30 days

cost.description: Show per-operation (per-tool) token cost. Defaults to a workspace 30-day window; scope with --task / --session

criteria audit.description: Show the workspace referent-kind distribution + self-confirming-green ratio (GET /api/criteria/audit)

crossing.description: Inspect, annotate and (with user approval) disposition boundary crossings

--confirm.description: Step 3: the user approved the ruling (never add this on your own initiative). Refused unless the read was confirmed first

--confirm-read.description: Step 2: the user confirmed they have read the envelope (never add this on your own initiative). Returns the ruling envelope; writes nothing

--confirmed.description: Rule the crossing confirmed (a real issue, acknowledged)

--false-positive.description: Rule the crossing a false positive (not a real issue)

--note.description: Optional disposition note recorded with the ruling

--receipt.description: Read receipt from the previous step's envelope (its confirmCommand carries it); required with --confirm-read (stage 1 receipt) and --confirm (stage 2 receipt), verified server-side

--task.description: Task the crossing belongs to (defaults to the session-bound task)

crossing disposition.description: Rule on a boundary crossing from the terminal (LUM-769) through a three-step confirmation handshake the server enforces: (1) no step flag — prints the crossing (severity, detail, agent explanations) as an envelope with a stage-1 read receipt, exit 4, writes nothing; (2) --confirm-read --receipt <r1> after the user confirms they READ it — returns the stage-2 receipt and a second envelope for the ruling, exit 4; (3) --confirm --receipt <r2> after the user approves the ruling — writes. Confirming before the read is acknowledged is refused and told to confirm the read first. Relay each envelope; never supply a step flag yourself. Either ruling clears the crossing's block on DONE and is audited as a CLI-channel disposition. Reverting to OPEN and repository suppression rules stay web-only. Targets a crossing on the session-bound task unless --task is given.

--note.description: The explanation to record (the rationale for the action / why it may be a false positive)

crossing explain.description: Append an agent self-explanation ("申辩") to a boundary crossing (LUM-542). Append-only and for the human reviewer — it never clears the crossing or unblocks Done (a human dispositions that). Targets a crossing on the session-bound task.

--if-revision.description: Only apply if the doc body is still at this revision (from doc show)

--section.description: Heading of the section to append into (omit to append at the document end)

doc append.description: Append markdown at the end of a heading-addressed section (before the next same-or-higher heading), or at the document end when --section is omitted. Pure insertion — no existing byte is modified — which makes it the safest write for running logs/ledgers. 409 on concurrent edits.

doc bind.description: Bind a document to a task by adding an EXPLICIT mention row. Idempotent. If a CONTENT-derived mention already exists for the same pair, it is upgraded to EXPLICIT so `doc unbind` can later remove it.

--parent.description: File under this parent doc (cuid or title)

--project.description: Project name or slug to file under

--task.description: Bind to this task after creation

doc create.description: Create a new document. Body comes from --content, --file, or piped stdin (pick one). --scope defaults to personal. Use --task LUM-N to bind the new doc to a task, --parent to file it under another doc.

--confirm.description: The user has approved the change shown in the confirmation envelope (LUM-755). Without it the command exits 4 and prints what it would do.

doc delete.description: Delete a document and everything nested under it. Without --confirm: exit 4 + a confirmation envelope with the title.

--file.description: Local markdown file to compare against

doc diff.description: Compare the server-side markdown source against a local file. Exit 0 when byte-identical, 1 with a unified diff when divergent. Requires the doc to have a stored markdown source.

--task.description: Bind the imported doc to this task

doc import-gdoc.description: Import a Google Doc as a Lumo doc (one-way Google → Lumo)

--limit.description: Cap output to first N rows

--project.description: Filter by project name/slug

--task.description: Only docs bound to this task

doc list.description: List documents visible to the current user

doc move.description: Move a doc under a different parent or to top level. Exactly one of --parent or --root is required. The moved doc lands at the end of its new sibling list; reordering among siblings is web-UI only.

--allow-shrink.description: Let the patch through even when it drops tables/rows/headings within the addressed section (default: rejected with 422)

--if-revision.description: Only apply if the doc body is still at this revision (from doc show)

--section.description: Heading of the section to replace (prefix with #… to pin depth)

doc patch.description: Replace one heading-addressed section of the markdown source (heading line included), leaving every byte outside the section untouched. Requires the doc to have a stored markdown source. Commits conditionally on the body revision: a concurrent edit fails with 409 instead of being overwritten. A replacement that drops tables/rows/headings within the addressed section is rejected with 422 (structure guard) unless --allow-shrink is passed.

--allow-shrink.description: Commit even if the rebuilt source re-renders with fewer tables/rows/headings than the stored body (default: rejected with 422)

--confirm.description: The user has approved replacing the existing source (LUM-755); pair with --force as the envelope instructs

--force.description: Re-derive the source even when one already exists. Without it an existing source yields exit 4 + a confirmation envelope whose confirmCommand carries --force --confirm.

--if-revision.description: Only apply if the doc body is still at this revision (from doc show)

doc rebuild-source.description: Regenerate the stored markdown source from the doc's HTML body using a lossless serializer (tables/rows/headings round-trip), re-enabling doc show --raw / diff / patch / append for a source-less doc. The rebuilt source is structure-guarded: any table/tr/heading shrink is rejected with 422 (no silent flattening) unless --allow-shrink is passed. A doc that already has a source is refused with 409 unless --force re-derives it (replacing a byte-faithful source with a serializer-derived one).

doc share.description: Share a document with a workspace member. PRIVATE docs are auto-promoted to SHARED. <member> accepts "me", an email, or a display name.

doc share-list.description: List the members a document is shared with, as fixed-width rows: <displayName>  <ROLE>.

--raw.description: Print the stored markdown source verbatim (no header); errors if absent

--section.description: Print one heading-addressed section of the markdown source (prefix with #… to pin depth, e.g. "## Status")

doc show.description: Show document header and body (doc = title or cuid). --raw prints the byte-identical markdown source of the last markdown upload (a legal edit base); it errors when no markdown source is stored instead of falling back to the lossy HTML→markdown render. --section <heading> prints just that section of the markdown source (revision goes to stderr).

doc sync.description: Re-sync a Google-imported doc (overwrites the Lumo body)

doc unbind.description: Unbind a document from a task. Removes EXPLICIT mentions only — purely CONTENT-derived mentions (from @LUM-N in the body) cannot be removed via CLI and fail with 409; edit the doc body in the web UI instead.

doc unshare.description: Remove a member from a document's share list. Idempotent — prints "Not shared with …" if no row exists.

--allow-shrink.description: Let the update through even when it drops tables/rows/headings versus the stored body (default: rejected with 422)

--if-revision.description: Only apply if the doc body is still at this revision (from doc show); mismatch fails with a 409 conflict

--project.description: Project name/slug; pass "" to clear

--remove-tag.description: Remove tag by name (repeatable). Unknown names are find-or-create, so prefer --remove-tag-id to avoid orphan rows.

--remove-tag-id.description: Remove tag by id (repeatable). Unknown ids are a no-op.

--tag.description: Set tags by name (bulk replace, repeatable)

--tag-id.description: Set tags by id (bulk replace, repeatable)

doc update.description: Update an existing document. <doc> accepts a cuid or a case-insensitive title (ambiguous titles fail with candidates). Replacement body comes from --content, --file, or piped stdin (pick one). A body update that drops tables/rows/headings versus the stored body is rejected with 422 (structure guard) unless --allow-shrink is passed. --tag/--tag-id (bulk replace) cannot be combined with --add-tag/--add-tag-id/--remove-tag/--remove-tag-id.

--context.description: Free-text origin context for the idea

idea.description: Capture a team-level idea into the pool (<10s, no friction). Grabs the current Claude Code session id and its bound task as provenance; prints an I-prefixed id (e.g. LUM-I42). The transformer (Spec 2) consumes the pool.

idea web add.description: Attach a web link to an idea

idea web rm.description: Remove a web link from an idea

idea web show.description: Show the fetched web link body as plain text

initiative create.description: Create a team-level initiative directly from a goal statement — no plan run required. Prints the LUM-INIT-<n> id; --assumption records the bet behind it.

initiative list.description: List the team initiatives newest-first — each line shows the LUM-INIT-<n> id, status (ACTIVE|DONE|DROPPED) and goal.

memory.description: Operate on a single memory by id (see `lumo task memory` / `lumo project memory` to list/add)

--dry-run.description: preview proposed subsystem cards + which fine cards they fold; writes nothing

memory fold.description: Preview the autonomous topic-fold pass (folding itself runs daily, automatically). Requires --dry-run.

memory promote.description: Promote a TASK memory to PROJECT scope. Only when the lesson recurs across 2+ tasks.

--dry-run.description: List what would be pushed without sending

--project.description: Project to push to (name/slug/id); default = bound session

memory push.description: Upsync locally-authored memories (<memory-dir>/outbox/*.json, each {category, content}) to the team via the existing create-project-memory pipeline. Pushed files are removed from the outbox on success.

--confirm.description: The user has approved the change shown in the confirmation envelope (LUM-755). Without it the command exits 4 and prints what it would do.

memory rm.description: Delete a memory (hard delete). Without --confirm: exit 4 + a confirmation envelope showing the card.

memory show.description: Show one memory's full card by id (category + content). Use to pull the body of a memory you saw as a one-line index entry at session start.

--clean.description: Remove every file + index block sync owns (full rollback)

--dry-run.description: Print the reconcile plan without writing files

--no-anchor-check.description: Skip code-anchor staleness detection (the post-sync check that flags memories referencing deleted files/symbols)

--project.description: Project to sync (name/slug/id); default = bound session

memory sync.description: Downsync team memory into the local Claude Code memory store (team/*.md + a managed MEMORY.md block). Only touches files it owns; never clobbers your own memory. Resolves the project from the bound session unless --project is given.

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone add.description: Bind one or more tasks to a milestone in one call. <identifier> accepts a name or UUID; each <task> accepts LUM-N or UUID. Per-task result with a tally; partial failures do not roll back.

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone archive.description: Archive a milestone: hidden from `milestone list` by default, history and task links preserved, reversible with `milestone unarchive`. Identifier accepts UUID or name.

--json.description: Emit the raw structured changelog payload

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone changelog.description: Assemble a structured changelog from the milestone's DONE tasks + merged PRs + frozen claimSnapshot (pure assembly, no LLM; runs on any status). Headline counts carry a baseline vs prior completed milestones; every claim shows provenance. Identifier accepts a milestone name or UUID. --json emits the raw structured payload.

--project.description: Project name or slug

milestone create.description: Create a milestone. --project required when workspace has >1 project.

milestone criteria.description: Milestone-level exit criteria — the close contract (LUM-643). Drafted and adjudicated by the milestone steward (LUM-640) or a human; unresolved criteria refuse status→COMPLETED (human override via web only).

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone criteria list.description: List a milestone’s exit criteria: id, verdict (MET | NOT_MET | PENDING), provenance, referent kind, statement — plus whether the close gate is open.

--file.description: JSON array of criteria: [{"statement","referentKind":"EXTERNAL_FACT"|"AGENT_CONSTRUCTED_STATE"|"PENDING_OUTCOME"}] — no verifierType/checkpointer (exit criteria are adjudicated, not machine-run)

--human.description: Record a human contract revision (HUMAN_EDIT) transcribed from the conversation

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone criteria set.description: Submit the whole exit contract from a JSON file (full replace; adjudicated rows are tombstoned, their verdict trail survives). Default = steward/agent draft; --human records a transcribed HUMAN_EDIT revision. Locked with 409 once the milestone is COMPLETED.

--evidence.description: Evidence pointer backing a MET on EXTERNAL_FACT (URL, commit SHA, CI run, DB probe …)

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone criteria verdict.description: Adjudicate (裁定) one exit criterion: --met or --unmet, with optional --note. Grounding gate: --met on an EXTERNAL_FACT criterion requires --evidence (422 otherwise), and a PENDING_OUTCOME criterion can never be MET. <criterion> = id or ≥6-char id prefix from `criteria list`.

--confirm.description: The user has approved the change shown in the confirmation envelope (LUM-755). Without it the command exits 4 and prints what it would do.

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone delete.description: Delete a milestone. Tasks under it keep their data (milestoneId is cleared). Without --confirm: exit 4 + a confirmation envelope with the task count.

--all.description: Show both archived and non-archived milestones

--project.description: Project name or slug

milestone list.description: List milestones for a project. --project required when workspace has >1 project. By default only non-archived milestones are shown.

--project.description: Project name or slug

milestone move.description: Move one milestone before or after another. --before and --after are mutually exclusive; exactly one is required. --project required when workspace has >1 project.

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone remove.description: Unbind one or more tasks from a milestone in one call. Tasks not currently in the milestone are skipped (idempotent), never reassigned. <identifier> accepts a name or UUID; each <task> accepts LUM-N or UUID.

--project.description: Project name or slug

milestone reorder.description: Reorder a project's milestones. Pass every milestone (name or UUID) in the desired order. --project required when workspace has >1 project.

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone show.description: Show a milestone: status, dates, description, task counts, and tasks under it. Identifier accepts UUID or name.

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone summary.description: Show the AI-generated summary for a milestone. Identifier accepts a milestone name or UUID. Prints "(no summary generated yet)" when none exists. Use --retry to queue regeneration before fetching.

--not-claimable.description: Mark the listed tasks NOT agent-claimable

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone triage.description: Batch-mark tasks agent-claimable within a milestone (steward triage, LUM-646). Choose a direction: --claimable or --not-claimable. Tasks not in the milestone are skipped. <identifier> accepts a name or UUID; each <task> accepts LUM-N or UUID. `lumo next --claimable` then surfaces only claimable ∩ unblocked ∩ in-budget tasks.

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

milestone unarchive.description: Restore an archived milestone so it shows in `milestone list` again. Identifier accepts UUID or name.

--project.description: Project name or slug (when identifier is a name)

--start.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (empty string to clear)

--target.description: Target date YYYY-MM-DD (empty string to clear)

--token-budget.description: Advisory token budget, positive integer (empty string to clear). Overview shows burn vs budget; over-budget raises a risk-queue alert — never a hard gate.

milestone update.description: Update a milestone. Provide at least one of --name, --description, --start, --target, --token-budget. Use "" to clear nullable fields. Completion is derived from task completion (LUM-714) — there is no status flag.

--claimable.description: Only recommend agent-claimable tasks that are unblocked (F3) and within milestone budget (F2)

next.description: Recommend the next task(s) to work on, ranked by priority, active sprint, and due date. Prints top N (default 3); pick one and run `session attach` + `task context`. Use --claimable to restrict to the autonomy boundary (claimable ∩ unblocked ∩ in-budget).

--min.description: Per-bracket sample floor below which a rate is withheld (default 10)

outcome rate.description: Trust × post-hoc fate: per delivery-time forecast-confidence bracket, the post-hoc REJECTED rate from the outcome well. Honest by construction — thin brackets read "insufficient" and the high-vs-low comparison stays "inconclusive" until the well has enough signal. The rate is a LOWER BOUND (no signal = INCONCLUSIVE, never satisfied).

outcome show.description: Read the post-hoc outcome well for a task: the falsifier verdict (REJECTED | INCONCLUSIVE — never a "pass") plus its backing rejection signals. INCONCLUSIVE means no rejection on record, NOT satisfied.

--abandon-active.description: Abandon the team’s existing active run before starting a fresh one

plan.description: Start a design-thinking 转换器 run (聚类→对齐→成计划) and print the gate-A web deep-link. Refuses when a run is already active (see `lumo plan status`); --abandon-active abandons the prior run first. Editing/confirmation happen in web.

plan status.description: Print the active plan run’s current stage and the deep-link to its next gate; with no active run, prompts to run `lumo plan`.

pr.description: Inspect pull requests by number — linked to a task or not

--all.description: Every pushed head's scan, newest first, instead of the latest only

--full.description: Append the per-task hunt detail: commands (with gate refusals), step trace, stop arithmetic, wrap-up, sites, model, diff sizing

--repo.description: Narrow to one repo when the same PR number exists in several (the error lists the candidates)

pr scan.description: Security scans of one PR in the workspace, by PR number (LUM-788): the latest head by default — layer states (same labels as task status / the GitHub summary), every finding incl. dispositioned ones with disposition + source, and the hunt coverage line. Read-only; disposition is web-only.

priority.description: Declare the team priority (append-only). With [text] records it directly; with no argument prompts interactively for 1-3 sentences. A newer declaration supersedes the old without deleting it.

priority list.description: Print the team priority append history, newest-first (the current declaration is marked with *).

project list.description: List projects in the current workspace. Slug column matches `task create --project <ref>`.

--agent.description: Producing agent: claude-code | codex | cursor | gemini-cli | github-copilot | windsurf (case-insensitive; default claude-code)

project memory add.description: Record a PROJECT-scope memory. Use PROJECT scope only when the lesson helps any task in the project. <project> defaults to the bound task's project.

--steward.description: Bind as a STEWARD (governance) session to a milestone (id, name, or slug) instead of a task. Steward sessions plan and accept only: lumo verify is refused (409, no round burned), self-dispatch to in_progress is refused, and implementation commits/PRs are recorded as boundary crossings.

session attach.description: Attach the currently-running Claude Code session (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID) to a task — or, with --steward, to a MILESTONE as a governance session (LUM-640: plan/accept only). Either binding is a lifetime lock: re-attaching the same target is a no-op, anything else is refused — start a new session instead.

session status.description: Show what this Claude Code session is bound to: a task, a milestone (STEWARD governance session), or nothing.

--agent.description: Coding agent these hooks run under (claude-code, codex, cursor, gemini-cli, github-copilot, windsurf). Baked into every hook command. Defaults to claude-code.

--confirm.description: The user has approved the change shown in the confirmation envelope (LUM-755). Without it the command exits 4 and prints what it would do.

--move-all.description: Move all unfinished tasks to the next sprint

sprint close.description: Close an ACTIVE sprint. With no unfinished tasks, closes immediately. Pass --move-all to move unfinished tasks to the next sprint, or --backlog-all to return them to the backlog; either mode without --confirm exits 4 with a confirmation envelope listing the tasks that would move.

--name.description: Sprint name (server fills default when omitted)

sprint create.description: Create a draft sprint. --team required when workspace has >1 team. --start and --end (YYYY-MM-DD) required.

--confirm.description: The user has approved the change shown in the confirmation envelope (LUM-755). Without it the command exits 4 and prints what it would do.

sprint delete.description: Delete a DRAFT sprint. Without --confirm: exit 4 + a confirmation envelope with the task count. Server rejects ACTIVE/CLOSED sprints.

--limit.description: Show only the first N sprints

--status.description: Filter by status: draft | active | closed (case-insensitive)

sprint list.description: List sprints for a team. --team required when workspace has >1 team. Sorted newest first.

sprint remove.description: Remove a task from a sprint. <task> accepts LUM-N or UUID.

--team.description: Team name or UUID (when workspace has >1 team)

sprint show.description: Show a sprint: status, dates, progress, and tasks. Identifier accepts a sprint number or UUID.

sprint start.description: Transition a DRAFT sprint to ACTIVE.

--team.description: Team name or UUID (when workspace has >1 team)

sprint summary.description: Show the AI-generated summary for a sprint. Identifier accepts a sprint number or UUID. Prints "(no summary generated yet)" when none exists. Use --retry to queue regeneration before fetching.

--team.description: Team name or UUID (when workspace has >1 team)

sprint update.description: Update a sprint. Provide at least one of --name, --start, --end. Identifier accepts a sprint number or UUID. Empty strings are rejected — these fields cannot be cleared.

task artifact.description: Record spec-engineering artifacts (spec / plan / design …) on a task

--agent.description: Coding tool that produced the artifact: claude-code | codex | cursor | gemini-cli | github-copilot | windsurf (case-insensitive)

--file.description: File whose contents become the artifact body

--kind.description: Artifact kind, e.g. spec | plan | design (opaque)

--source.description: Spec-gen framework, formal name e.g. Superpowers | "Spec Kit" | BMad | OpenSpec | GSD (opaque; quote names with spaces)

task artifact add.description: Attach an artifact to a task. --kind/--title/--source are stored verbatim; --file supplies the content.

task artifact list.description: List artifacts attached to a task, in order

--confirm.description: The user has approved the change shown in the confirmation envelope (LUM-755). Without it the command exits 4 and prints what it would do.

task artifact rm.description: Delete an artifact from a task (irreversible). Without --confirm: exit 4 + a confirmation envelope naming the artifact.

task artifact show.description: Show one artifact (key:value header + content body). Find <artifact-id> in `artifact list` column 1.

--agent.description: New coding tool: claude-code | codex | cursor | gemini-cli | github-copilot | windsurf (case-insensitive)

--source.description: New spec-gen framework, formal name e.g. Superpowers | "Spec Kit" | BMad | OpenSpec | GSD (quote names with spaces)

task artifact update.description: Update an artifact’s kind / title / source (not content). Provide at least one flag.

task comment.description: Add a comment to a task. Body is plain text — quote it to pass spaces or newlines.

task comments.description: Inspect the full task comment thread

--full.description: Print every comment, bypassing the output-token cap

task comments list.description: List the task comment thread (capped to the output budget; --full prints every comment)

task context.description: Print a task + prior session summaries as markdown, for pasting into a coding agent on startup.

--new-scope.description: Declare this is genuinely new work, outside your current task’s scope

--priority.description: Priority: low | medium | high | urgent (case-insensitive; default: low)

--project.description: Project name or slug

--rework-of.description: Declare this is rework of an existing task (redirects you to fix it; creates nothing)

--sprint.description: Sprint number or UUID to add the task to after creation

task create.description: Create a task. --project required when workspace has >1 project; defaults: priority=low, assignee=me.

task criteria.description: Acceptance criteria — the task’s verification contract (LUM-342)

task criteria list.description: List a task’s acceptance criteria (id, type, provenance, checkpointer)

--cause.description: Why the contract drifted (with --human): NEW_INFO | SCOPE_CHANGE | DRAFT_BLIND_SPOT | GRANULARITY | OTHER (case-insensitive)

--human.description: Record a human contract revision (HUMAN_EDIT) transcribed from the conversation, with session provenance

task criteria set.description: Submit the whole acceptance contract from a JSON file. Default = initial agent draft (locked once submitted); --human records a HUMAN_EDIT revision (desired final list; items with "id" keep/update, missing ones are deleted).

task deps.description: Task dependency edges — detected candidates + confirmed blockers

--confirm.description: The user has approved the change shown in the confirmation envelope (LUM-755). Without it the command exits 4 and prints what it would do.

task deps rm.description: Delete a dependency edge. Without --confirm: exit 4 + a confirmation envelope describing the edge.

task figma.description: Attach Figma file/frame links to a task

task figma add.description: Attach a Figma file or frame URL to the given task. Fetches file/frame name + thumbnail via Figma OAuth.

task figma context.description: Show the cached Figma design context (metadata)

task figma list.description: List Figma links attached to a task

task figma refresh.description: Re-fetch Figma metadata + thumbnail for every link on this task. Per-link failures isolated.

task figma rm.description: Remove a Figma link from a task (idempotent)

task lineage.description: Show the causal trail: which context fragments fed this task, each fragment's outcome, and the token/loop cost of the run that consumed it

--limit.description: Show only the first N tasks

--milestone.description: Filter by milestone name or UUID (scopes to my tasks under that milestone)

--project.description: Filter by project name (case-insensitive)

--status.description: Filter by status: todo | in_progress | in_review | done (case-insensitive)

task list.description: List tasks assigned to you. Filter with --status, --project, --milestone, --limit.

task memory.description: View and record memories scoped to a task

--agent.description: Producing agent: claude-code | codex | cursor | gemini-cli | github-copilot | windsurf (case-insensitive; default claude-code)

--trigger.description: trap/procedural: the situation that triggers it

task memory add.description: Record a memory on a task (<task> defaults to the bound session). Record only knowledge invisible in the codebase (the why, a runtime gotcha, a non-obvious failure, a non-trivial workflow); skip routine work. Pick --category then its fields.

--limit.description: Cap output to the first N rows

task memory list.description: List a task's memories. <task> defaults to the session-bound task.

task pr show.description: Show the synced PR record (diff/review comments when available)

task show.description: Show a single task: title, status, priority, assignee, project, URL, description.

task slack show.description: Show the full stored Slack thread snapshot

--full.description: Also print the dashboard sections: verification rollup, history, cost, struggle/rework trail, trend

--json.description: Emit the versioned machine-readable payload (version field; breaking changes bump it)

task status.description: Acceptance self-check (LUM-344): contract with latest verdicts, current round, nextActions (unmet criteria + undispositioned security findings, LUM-737), and open boundary crossings. Read-only, no LLM. Defaults to the session-bound task. Run it first when resuming a task or after a verification round was rejected. --full adds the dashboard sections (verification rollup, history, cost, struggle/rework trail, trend).

--assignee.description: New assignee: email, name, or "me" (empty string to clear)

--claimable.description: Mark the task agent-claimable (surfaces in `lumo next --claimable`)

--confirm.description: With --status done: the user has approved the DONE transition shown in the confirmation envelope (LUM-755). Without it, --status done exits 4 and prints the envelope (status change, every linked PR, a ⚠ line for unmerged ones) instead of a prompt.

--milestone.description: Milestone name (case-insensitive); empty string to unbind

--not-claimable.description: Mark the task NOT agent-claimable (mutually exclusive with --claimable)

--priority.description: New priority: low | medium | high | urgent (case-insensitive)

--remove-tag.description: Remove tag by name (repeatable). Unknown names are find-or-create, so prefer --remove-tag-id to avoid orphan rows.

--remove-tag-id.description: Remove tag by id (repeatable). Unknown ids are a no-op.

--sprint.description: Sprint number or UUID to bind the task to; empty string to unbind from current sprint

--status.description: New status: todo | in_progress | in_review | done (case-insensitive)

--tag.description: Set tags by name (bulk replace, repeatable)

--tag-id.description: Set tags by id (bulk replace, repeatable)

task update.description: Update a task. Provide at least one of --title, --description, --status, --priority, --assignee, --milestone, --sprint, or tag flags. Use "" to clear description, assignee, milestone, or sprint binding. --tag/--tag-id (bulk replace) cannot be combined with --add-tag/--add-tag-id/--remove-tag/--remove-tag-id.

task web show.description: Show the fetched web link body as plain text

update.description: Check npm for a newer @lumoai/cli and install it globally if available.

--note.description: Optional one-line self-report — what you did and why it is ready. When given, it is recorded as your claim (source AGENT) when the round passes into IN_REVIEW.

verify.description: Machine verification loop (LUM-343): run every MACHINE criterion checkpointer locally, report structured verdicts to the server (round cap 3), and print next actions. All-pass moves the task to IN_REVIEW. Defaults to the session-bound task.

worktree.description: Scaffold, remove, and list parallel git worktrees under .worktrees/ (node_modules symlink + prisma/jest gotcha guidance). Local dev tooling; run from the main checkout.

--base.description: Branch off this ref instead of origin/main (skips fetch)

--no-fetch.description: Do not `git fetch origin main` before branching

--verify.description: Run `npx jest` in the new worktree to confirm a clean baseline

worktree add.description: Create a worktree at .worktrees/<LUM-N>[-slug] on branch lumo/<LUM-N>[-slug] off origin/main, symlink node_modules to the main checkout, and print prisma/jest guidance. Run from the main checkout.

worktree list.description: List worktrees under .worktrees/: task id, branch, dirty state, and whether node_modules is symlinked.

--confirm.description: The user has approved the change shown in the confirmation envelope (LUM-755). Without it the command exits 4 and prints what it would do.

--delete-branch.description: Also delete the branch (git branch -d; refuses if unmerged)

--force.description: Remove even with uncommitted changes (discards them)

worktree rm.description: Remove the worktree for a task (git worktree remove). Without --confirm — or with uncommitted changes and no --force — exits 4 with a confirmation envelope naming the path, branch and what would be discarded. Keeps the branch unless --delete-branch.
